第1572章 极度危机1（第1页）
看到杨凡逃脱了险境，宇文元天的脸色阴沉无比，如今杨凡已经进入了屠龙部落人群之中，他再想出手击杀杨凡也是不可能的了。
“杨凡，怎么样？没事吧？”。狼祖问道。
与这宇文元天对战杨凡颇为吃亏，而且也受了一些伤势，但是并不算严重，稍微调息一下便可以恢复过来。
杨凡说道，“我没事，很快就能够恢复”。
瑶姬公主，天老率领的妖族族老已经与屠龙部落的人汇合在了一起，此外，雷暴刀君，裂天鹰等人也都在万族之中撕开了一个缺口，成功与大家汇聚在了一起。
“杨兄弟，我就知道你会及时赶到的，这一次我们部落若是能够脱困便全靠你了”。公孙大牛跑了过来，给杨凡来了一个重重的熊抱。
“都是兄弟，客气什么”。杨凡苦笑着说道。
“这位便是杨少侠吧？果然是英雄出少年啊”。公孙老族长也走了过来，看向杨凡的目光带着一丝感激的神色。
“这是我爷爷”。公孙大牛介绍道。
杨凡赶紧行礼，道，“前辈不要客气，我与大牛也是生死之交，此番屠龙部落遭遇危机又岂能坐视不理？”。
公孙老族长赞叹道，“侠骨心肠，老夫的的确确是打心底佩服啊”。
这个时候瘸子老爹也回来了，连忙说道，“多谢杨少侠的救命之恩啊，大牛能够交你这样一个朋友也是大牛的福分啊”。
屠龙部落的人你一句我一句的说的杨凡倒是有些不好意思了。
杨凡说道，“诸位前辈务虚客气，现如今万族仍然虎视眈眈，咱们的力量还是太过于薄弱了，不宜分开，应该汇聚在一起，相互为依托，暂时抵挡住万族这些人，这一战最为主要的还是要看几位地仙级别强者的战斗，我们若是能够挺到那个时候，危局自解”。
“地仙级别的战斗？”。公孙老族长说道，“对方有四尊地仙，这一战似乎………”。他叹了一口气，道，“要不，咱们选择退走吧，有两尊地仙在，退出去应该不成问题”。
杨凡说道，“退出去的话怕会造成更大的伤亡，你们放心，大鹏王同阶无敌，虽说现在大鹏王被三尊地仙围困，但是根本不会败落的”。
众人朝着大鹏王那片战场望去，果然看到，在三尊地仙级别强者的围攻之下大鹏王仍然显得游刃有余的样子，任凭对方攻势山呼海啸，大鹏王应付起来并不算困难，显得十分从容，这也给了屠龙部落这些人极大的信心与鼓舞。

“好，大家汇聚在一起，互为攻守，抵挡万族这些人的围攻”。公孙老族长大声喝道。
只是现如今屠龙部落加上妖族的高手也不过只有四百人的样子，万族的高手五倍于他们，所以想要抵挡住万族高手的围攻也并不容易，单是那种强大的消耗就承受不了，毕竟对方人数太多了，源源不断的消耗下去，屠龙部落与妖族的人力量消耗完了，但是万族的人数多啊，人家还储备着力量，到时候便是一面倒的屠杀。
知道这一点又能如何呢？现在也没有别的更好办法，好在狼祖，饕餮等人的到来补充了最为缺失的人仙力量，有了这几尊人仙，还有龟祖这尊半步地仙，以及虽然不是半步地仙但是实力比半步地仙还要强大的瑶姬公主等人的帮忙，万族想要快速的撕裂屠龙部落与妖族共同的防御层也并不是一件容易的事情。
杨凡趁着这个机会开始休养，调整自己的状态。

Chapter 1572 Extreme Crisis 1 (Page 1)
Seeing Yang Fan escaping from danger, Yuwen Yuantian's face was extremely gloomy. Now that Yang Fan had entered the crowd of the Dragon Slaying Tribe, it was impossible for him to kill Yang Fan again.
"Yang Fan, how are you? Are you okay?". Ancestor Wolf asked.
Yang Fan suffered a lot in the battle with Yuwen Yuantian, and he also suffered some injuries, but they were not serious and he could recover with a little breath adjustment.
Yang Fan said, "I'm fine and I'll recover soon."
Princess Yao Ji and the demon tribe elders led by Tian Lao have already merged with the people of the Dragon Slaying Tribe. In addition, Lord Thunderstorm Sword, Splitting Sky Eagle and others have also opened a gap among the tribes and successfully reunited with everyone.
"Brother Yang, I knew you would arrive in time. If our tribe can get out of trouble this time, it will all depend on you." Gongsun Daniu ran over and gave Yang Fan a heavy bear hug.
"We are all brothers, no need to be polite." Yang Fan said with a wry smile.
"This is Young Master Yang, right? He is indeed a boy born from a hero." Patriarch Gongsun also came over and looked at Yang Fan with a hint of gratitude.
"This is my grandpa." Gongsun Daniu introduced.
Yang Fan quickly saluted and said, "Senior, don't be polite. Daniel and I are also close friends of life and death. How can we just sit idly by and ignore the crisis that the Dragon Slaying Tribe is facing this time?"
The old patriarch Gongsun praised him, "I really admire his chivalrous heart from the bottom of his heart."
At this time, Lame Man's father also came back and said quickly, "Thank you so much, Young Master Yang, for saving my life. It's Daniel's blessing to be able to make a friend like you."
The people from the Dragon Slaying Tribe said something to each other, which made Yang Fan feel a little embarrassed.
Yang Fan said, "Seniors, please be polite and courteous. Nowadays, the Ten Thousand Clans are still eyeing us. Our strength is still too weak to be separated. We should gather together and rely on each other to temporarily resist the Ten Thousand Clans. The most important thing in this battle is the battle of several Earth Immortal-level powerhouses. If we can survive until that time, the crisis will be solved."
"A battle at the level of an Earth Immortal?". Elder Patriarch Gongsun said, "There are four Earth Immortals on the other side. This battle seems...". He sighed and said, "How about we choose to retreat? With the two Earth Immortals here, retreating shouldn't be a problem."
Yang Fan said, "If we withdraw, we may cause greater casualties. Don't worry, King Dapeng is invincible at the same level. Although King Dapeng is now besieged by three earth immortals, he will not be defeated at all."
Everyone looked towards the battlefield of King Dapeng, and sure enough they saw that King Dapeng still seemed to be able to handle it under the siege of three powerful men of the Earth Immortal level. Despite the opponent's offensive, King Dapeng was not difficult to deal with, and he appeared to be very calm. This also gave the people of the Dragon Slaying Tribe great confidence and encouragement.
"Okay, let's get together and attack and defend each other to resist the siege of these people of all races." Old patriarch Gongsun shouted loudly.
It’s just that now there are only 400 experts from the Dragon Slaying Tribe plus the Demon Clan. The experts from the Ten Thousand Clan are five times as many as them, so it is not easy to withstand the siege of the Ten Thousand Clan masters. The powerful consumption alone cannot be tolerated.
So what if you know this? There is no other better way now. Fortunately, the arrival of Wolf Ancestor, Taotie and others have supplemented the most missing human immortal power. With these human immortals,With the help of the Half-Step Earth Immortal Gui Zu, and Princess Yao Ji, who is not a Half-Step Earth Immortal but is more powerful than the Half-Step Earth Immortal, it is not easy for the Wanzu to quickly tear apart the common defense layer of the Dragon Slaying Tribe and the Monster Tribe.
Yang Fan took this opportunity to recuperate and adjust his condition.
